title: xena.wtf
description: a server-that is anarchy, you can grief and kill players but no hacking :)
body:
XENA server is basically what happens when you take Minecraft, remove the concept of “peace,” and then quietly whisper “good luck” and leave.
It’s not a server, it’s a social experiment that forgot it was an experiment.
You spawn in thinking you’re gonna build a cute little base. Cute idea. Within like 10 minutes someone’s already:


griefing a village for fun


starting a “totally justified” war over 3 dirt blocks


or speedrunning emotional damage in chat ☠️


Drama? Oh it’s not occasional. It’s scheduled. Random argument? Congrats, that’s now a 3-day arc with alliances, betrayals, and someone quitting dramatically only to rejoin 20 minutes later like nothing happened.
Bases don’t last. They survive briefly out of respect, then get deleted by either chaos, revenge, or “I was bored bro.”
And somehow everyone still comes back like:
“this time will be chill”
No it won’t. It never is. It just cycles between peace and absolute digital disaster.
XENA isn’t Minecraft multiplayer.
It’s Minecraft: emotional damage edition.
